readingTime.en: About {minutes} min of text; explore the figures at your own pace
readingTime.zh: 正文约{minutes}分钟，图表可自行探索

liquidityTitle.en: Compare the same activity measure under two size definitions
liquidityTitle.zh: 用两种规模定义比较同一成交指标

liquidityIntro.en: Change the period, size basis and group. Missing markets remain in the table; an absent value is not a zero.
liquidityIntro.zh: 可以切换时期、规模口径和分组。缺失市场仍保留在表格中，没有数值不等于零。

metric.zh: 此前20个交易日平均成交额的中位数（美元）

missingMarket.en: Market not included in this period
missingMarket.zh: 该时期没有纳入该市场

missingValue.en: No retained value in this group

riskTitle.zh: 早期不同持仓数量的风险汇总

riskScope.en: 2008–2014 retained summaries only. The longest underwater duration counts trading sessions in completed episodes; each size has an unresolved right-censored episode. Unknown classified prices are held flat, and ST/suspension history is incomplete. These values cannot generate five daily NAV curves.
riskScope.zh: 仅展示2008至2014年保留汇总。最长水下期统计已恢复事件中的交易日，各数量仍有未完成恢复的右删失事件。已分类未知价格按前值持平，ST与停牌历史不完整。这些汇总不能生成五条逐日净值。

underwater.zh: 已恢复事件中的最长水下期（交易日）

inlineNote.en: These figures use their stated sources and samples. They are not a second portfolio account.
inlineNote.zh: 图表沿用注明的来源与样本，没有另造一份组合账户。

chapterIntro.en: Read each investigation as a research essay, with interactive evidence beside the argument. Methods and historical results keep their stated scope and uncertainty.
chapterIntro.zh: 每篇调查围绕一个问题展开，互动证据放在相关论述旁边。方法和历史结果都保留各自的适用范围与不确定性。

figureHelp.en: The two risk measures use separate scales. On narrow screens, scroll the figure or table horizontally to inspect exact values.
figureHelp.zh: 两项风险指标各有刻度，柱形长度不能直接比较。窄屏可横向滚动图表或表格，查看精确数值。

tableHelp.en: On narrow screens, scroll the chart or table horizontally. Exact values and sample counts remain in the table.
tableHelp.zh: 窄屏可横向滚动图表或表格，表中保留精确数值与样本数量。
